appraisal_events.evidence: Mais comment, s'écria mon père, ennuyé de l'impression fâcheuse que l'aveu de mon incompréhension pouvait produire sur M. de Norpois, comment peux-tu dire que tu n'as pas eu de plaisir? ta grand'mère nous a raconté que tu ne perdais pas un mot...
appraisal_events.explanation: Worried about the bad impression on Norpois, the father sharply challenges the narrator's admission of disappointment, using the grandmother's contrary account to override his own testimony.

appraisal_events.evidence: dit M. de Norpois en se tournant avec application vers ma mère pour ne pas la laisser en dehors de la conversation et afin de remplir consciencieusement son devoir de politesse envers une maîtresse de maison.
appraisal_events.explanation: Norpois deliberately turns to draw the mother into the conversation as a courtesy to his hostess, bringing her inside an exchange from which she had earlier held herself apart.

appraisal_events.evidence: c'est le goût parfait qu'elle apporte dans le choix de ses rôles et qui lui vaut toujours un franc succès, et de bon aloi ... Jamais de couleurs trop voyantes, de cris exagérés. Et puis cette voix admirable qui la sert si bien et dont elle joue à ravir.
appraisal_events.explanation: Norpois delivers an authoritative, detailed endorsement of la Berma's taste, restraint, and voice, confirming her excellence with the weight of expert judgment.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator is put on the spot and corrected by his father's anxious insistence, his own account of disappointment overridden by secondhand testimony.
Norpois deliberately brings her into the conversation as hostess, reversing her earlier position at its margin.
Norpois's detailed, expert praise of her taste, restraint, and voice strongly confirms her excellence.

ambiguities: The narrator's closing conviction that he was not disappointed after all is shown as swayed by Norpois's authoritative praise, with a faintly ironic simile comparing his absorption of these borrowed reasons to a drunk man's sentimental enthusiasm, so this shift in his own judgment is not recorded as an independent status effect.
